note: Past flood events from news reports, for reference. Roads listed under flood_prone get a small routing caution (+0.5). This is not a closure and does not replace live sensors or responder reports.

events.name: Chennai floods, November-December 2015
events.summary: Heavy rain flooded much of south Chennai. Velachery flooded more than older parts of the city; when outlets from the Velachery and Adambakkam lakes to the Pallikaranai marsh were blocked, water came back into the streets.

events.name: Cyclone Michaung, December 2023
events.summary: Velachery Main Road was heavily flooded. Parts of Velachery, Madipakkam, Adyar and Pallikaranai stayed inundated for days after the rain stopped, and drainage gaps were blamed.
